items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So some years later I met Mr. Bill Bailey, and he had come along with a different way of doing a Bubbles tap step

ctx.x: So some years later I met Mr. Bill Bailey, and he had come along with a different way of doing a Bubbles tap step, which was a cramp. But Mr. Bailey did it down on the floor with the whole foot. He didn't kick it. He didn't kick the cramp. He

walked it, see. That was something like this. (Tap dancing.) That's a walking cramp. (Tap dancing.) Hear all the taps? That's a cramp. It's a cramp rhythm. (Tap dancing) See, Bubbles'? Bailey's. (Tap dancing.) Like that, see. That's a kick cramp. A kick cramp and the walking cramp, see. So there now, I figured that's a good idea. I better continue change it to teach myself different ways of doing Mr. Bubbles' tap steps. And that's what I have done up to this day, until I got to the "A Train". So now I'm on the "A…
Well, we'll have a chance to hear that later. When we get up to that period.
